verification_instructions: Run `npm run type-check` for TypeScript validation, `npm run lint` for ESLint, `npm run test` for unit tests, `npm run build` for production build verification. Start dev server with `npm run dev` and manually verify UI changes at http://localhost:5173
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - no snapshot tests or generated code checked in
environment_constraints: Backend API runs on localhost:8000 (vite proxy configured at /api). Do NOT modify backend. Frontend uses React Router 6.21. No state management library (useState/useEffect only). All Turkish UI text. Accessibility required (keyboard nav, focus states, prefers-reduced-motion). Backend returns mensione_pick, prediction_version_id, predicted_score in MatchPredictionResponse but market_analysis is deprecated in favor of mensione_pick structure.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: Always inspect files before editing. Work in small verifiable steps. Never claim implemented/tested without verification. Keep mock data labeled. Never invent statistics. AI Analyst is explanation layer only. Backend is Python+FastAPI (do not modify). Frontend is React+TypeScript+Vite. Keep code in English, UI text Turkish. Fix errors during verification instead of just reporting. Update docs/PROGRESS.md after completion.
key_patterns: Pages in src/pages/*.tsx with matching *.css. Components in src/components/common/ and src/components/layout/. API client in src/api/client.ts with types in src/api/types.ts. Utilities in src/utils/. AppLayout wrapper provides Sidebar + Header. Turkish locale used throughout (tr-TR). ProbabilityDisplay, ConfidenceIndicator, ValueIndicator components exist but need replacement for MENSIONE green theme. Current theme: purple galaxy (--color-accent-purple, glow effects) - must be completely replaced. Design tokens defined in src/styles/global.css with CSS variables.
